title: graphite check --json envelope (v1)
description: Response of `graphite check <path> --json`: whether the graph matches the working tree. stale:false means it does; stale:true carries a reason (source changes, engine_changed, missing manifest, ...). Top-level additional keys are allowed (additive evolution; additionalProperties:true is explicit because graphite's subset validator treats absence as closed); the keys listed as required here are the stable v1 surface. Note for consumers reusing graphite's subset validator (routing/schema_validation.py): it treats ABSENT additionalProperties as closed, so every deliberately open object in this file says additionalProperties:true explicitly.

engine_delta.description: Present when reason is engine_changed. Names which part of the engine identity moved, and what it moved from and to, so the next occurrence explains itself. previous is null when no identity was recorded at all (a legacy or corrupt manifest), in which case every part of the current identity is new.
